# ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ...) over INTERVAL values
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/aggregate_functions#array_agg
#
# DISTINCT compares INTERVAL values by length, with 30 days to a month, so these are equal.

# Which of the equal values the result keeps.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i)) FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 30 DAY, INTERVAL 1 MONTH]) AS i
?>

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i)) FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 30 DAY]) AS i
?>

# Which of the equal values the result keeps where ORDER BY places the others between them.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i ORDER BY i))
FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 1 DAY, INTERVAL 720 HOUR, INTERVAL 30 DAY]) AS i
?>
